reason: A structured skill system for guiding AI agents through reproducible research, including staged planning, information collection, data processing, analysis, and reporting practices.

summaries.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供可复现科研工作的分阶段方法、约束与状态管理指导。
summaries.en: Provides staged methods, constraints, and state-management guidance for AI agents conducting reproducible research.

capabilities: Guides an AI agent through a staged research workflow
Provides methods for information collection, data processing, planning, analysis, and result handling
Defines reproducibility, traceability, state management, and project logging practices
Includes a research-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness
